verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at https://tailscale.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and a rich docs index at /docs/llms.txt covers many KB pages, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The docs also offer an installable Tailscale skill so coding agents can work with Tailscale configuration and code. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents consume these docs effectively in practice.
